survey.title: High School Student Satisfaction Survey
survey.description: Collects student feedback on teaching quality, classroom environment, facilities, and wellbeing to guide school improvements.
survey.welcome_text: Welcome! We appreciate your input on teaching, environment, facilities, and wellbeing. Your responses are confidential and will help enhance our school experience.
survey.end_text: Thank you for sharing your thoughts and helping us improve!
survey.request: Create a student satisfaction survey for a high school covering teaching quality, classroom environment, facilities and student wellbeing.

groups.name: Teaching & Learning
groups.description: Evaluates the quality of instruction and classroom dynamics.

questions.text: What aspects of teaching methods help you learn best in class?
Which teaching approach do you find most effective for your learning?
Which of the following classroom practices do you find most supportive of your learning?
Please list up to three specific teaching practices that you feel most improve your learning experience.

groups.name: Facilities & Wellbeing
groups.description: Assesses school facilities and student wellbeing support.

questions.text: Please indicate your level of agreement with the following statements about the school's facilities and student wellbeing support.
subquestions: The classrooms are clean and well‑maintained
The school provides adequate recreational facilities
The cafeteria offers healthy food options
The counseling services effectively support student wellbeing

questions.text: How satisfied are you with the availability of quiet study spaces in the school?
Please describe any improvements or changes you would like to see in the school's facilities or wellbeing services to better support your learning and health.
Do you feel the school provides adequate mental health resources for students?
What single change to the school's facilities or wellbeing services would most improve your daily school experience?
